implementation.failure_record: FailureRecord v1 is Controller-owned durable evidence bound to the active plan revision/digest, task/task-contract digest, failed attempt, stable normalized failure signature/code, bounded actionable synopsis, failed-action facts, exact evidence references, confidence and routing decision. Ordinary execution/proposal/verification failures do not claim assumption/precondition invalidation without explicit evidence.
implementation.repair_packet: RepairPacket v1 binds the same immutable plan/task/acceptance contract plus prior attempt, FailureRecord digest/signature/evidence and a bounded ContextMode::Repair packet containing current diff, compact actionable failure evidence and implicated source/tool evidence while excluding prior transcript, raw tool logs and hidden reasoning.
implementation.controller_authority: Only Controller admits repair from repair_pending (or its exact resource-deferred continuation), rechecks active-plan/task/acceptance identity and durable counters, derives fresh readiness/resource authority, starts a new attempt, and reuses the normal typed model proposal -> authorization -> tool -> deterministic verifier path. No PlanCompiler call occurs during repair and the valid plan/task contract is not rewritten.
implementation.counter_semantics: max_attempts counts only actual started attempts, including the initial attempt; same_failure_limit is independently enforced over normalized failure signatures. Pre-attempt resource admission uses a separate bounded resource-deferral counter and does not increment attempts_started or model_calls_used.
implementation.restart_provenance: FailureRecord and RepairPacket records are checkpoint-immutable bindings. Repair attempt runtime persists explicit prior-attempt, FailureRecord-digest and RepairPacket-digest provenance, so RecoveryManager reconstructs counters and repair ancestry without chat/model replay.
implementation.failure_normalization: Failure signatures use stable category/code plus normalized diagnostic/action facts and strip volatile request IDs, timestamps, line-number/digit noise, content digests and action identity. Actionable diagnostics remain present in the model-facing FailureSynopsis even though volatile identity is removed from the circuit-breaker key.
implementation.failure_policy: Controller applies the immutable task failure_policy for execution failure and attempts/same-failure exhaustion; unsupported/escalating routes fail closed rather than creating an extra retry.
